Insight local OCR runtime

Pinned packages:
- tesseract.js 7.0.0
- tesseract.js-core 7.0.0
- @tesseract.js-data/jpn 1.0.0 (4.0.0_best_int/jpn.traineddata.gz)

Runtime policy:
- Assets are served from the same Insight origin.
- OCR images are not uploaded to these projects or any external OCR service.
- Tesseract language caching is disabled by Insight.
